description: This file defines the httpCache class, which provides methods for HTTP caching, including caching files and content, checking modification times, and handling HTTP headers related to caching.

classes.name: httpCache
classes.description: A helper class for managing HTTP cache headers and cache content for files and data.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Caches a file by setting appropriate HTTP headers based on its MIME type and modification time.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Caches provided content with specified modification time, MIME type, and expiration, sending appropriate HTTP headers.

methods.name: checkMTime
methods.description: Checks if the client's cached version is up-to-date based on modification time and sends a 304 response if so.
